title: Large Language Models Polarize Ideologically but Moderate Affectively in Online Political Discourse
abstract: arXiv:2601.20238v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) is reshaping how people engage in political discourse online. We examine how the release of ChatGPT altered ideological and emotional patterns in Reddit's largest political forum. Analysis of millions of comments shows that ChatGPT intensified ideological polarization: liberal-leaning authors posted increasingly liberal comments, while conservative-leaning authors posted increasingly conservative comments. Multiple falsification tests suggest that these findings are unlikely to be driven by contemporaneous events, such as the 2022 U.S. midterm elections, or by broader platform-wide trends in political polarization. translated_title: 大型语言模型在在线政治话语中加剧意识形态极化但缓和情感表达
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.20238v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）的出现正在重塑人们在线上政治话语中的参与方式。我们研究了ChatGPT的发布如何改变了Reddit上最大的政治论坛中的意识形态和情感模式。对数百万条评论的分析表明，ChatGPT加剧了意识形态极化：倾向自由派的作者发布越来越自由派的评论，而倾向保守派的作者发布越来越保守派的评论。多项证伪测试表明，这些发现不太可能由同期事件（如2022年美国中期选举）或平台上更广泛的政治极化趋势所驱动。机制测试显示，这种转变并非源于使用LLM生成更具说服力或意识形态更极端的原创内容，而是源于LLM辅助评论倾向于回响并强化原帖观点的趋势，这一模式与情感缓和效应一致。
tldr: 这项研究揭示，ChatGPT的引入在Reddit政治论坛中加剧了意识形态极化，但这一现象并非来自生成更极端的内容，而是LLM辅助评论倾向于附和原帖立场，同时缓和了情感表达。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that ChatGPT's introduction intensified ideological polarization in Reddit's political forum, but this effect stems not from generating more extreme content but from LLM-assisted comments echoing original post viewpoints while moderating emotional expression.
